changelog: v1.5.0 Wireless RTMP Ingest & Clean UI: 1) Embedded RTMP Ingest Server (0.0.0.0:1935) ingests Sony A7 IV 1080p 60fps wireless network streams over both Mobile Hotspot (192.168.43.1) and shared Wi-Fi simultaneously. 2) Hardware H.264 preview decoder for smooth 60fps camera monitoring. 3) Direct zero-reencode restreaming to YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and OBS Studio. 4) Complete UI redesign with 4 focused landing screens (Live, Broadcast, Overlays, Settings) and clean 2x2 grid cards.
